_: Kill-check for asc-xqf1's test. `evidence_record` carries `arms`, and `predictions` beside it, as `json` properties -- the shape that makes a losing arm or a refuted prediction a queryable field instead of prose. This mutant makes `types define` refuse a `json` property at runtime while leaving the build intact, so the round trip breaks for the reason the test exists and for no other. Killer name was read off `assertionResults` of `vitest run packages/cli/test/types.test.ts --reporter=json`, not guessed. NOTE: deleting 'json' from PROPERTY_TYPES in packages/core/src/spec.ts is NOT a usable mutant -- packages/cli/src/starters.ts declares three `json` properties, so that edit fails `tsc -b` and the whole file reports 72 skipped rather than one kill. It breaks the build, it does not isolate the check.

mutants.replace: if (type === 'json' || typeof type !== 'string' || !(PROPERTY_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(type)) {

killers.test: keeps the json property, uncoerced, through define and export
